prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high-fidelity 1440x900 landscape desktop app screen for SoloDesk, rendered edge to edge, crisp readable text, no external browser frame or physical desk. The attached image is the supplied SoloDesk logo mark only; preserve its identity where it appears, not its background or scale. SoloDesk helps freelance engineers and small teams manage delivery, time and invoices. Indigo Workshop uses matte indigo #202C49 shell, off-white #F6F7FB work surfaces, and violet-blue #4E4BB8 primary actions. Modern humanist sans typography, spacious review panels, and a clearly labeled review queue translate an architecture studio's review ritual into an ordinary business app; no blueprints or pinboard imagery. A review queue leads beside a broad contextual project inspector, with standard navigation. Include SoloDesk branding, workspace 'Studio', navigation Overview, My work, Projects, Clients, Time, Finance, Reports; global search, timer 00:42:18 and sync status. Main real illustrative work rows: 'Review API contract' / Atlas API / In review / Today; 'Prepare release checklist' / Client platform / In progress / Tomorrow; 'Confirm onboarding access' / New client / Blocked / 19 Oct. Include 'New task', clear table headings, one unobtrusive 'Working offline — changes save on this device; invoice issuance requires a connection' banner, and small 'Illustrative data' label. Spacious controls and generous row heights, familiar native-style buttons and menus. Use the first viewport and enough lower content to prove a full working screen. No decorative charts, giant revenue claims, gradient text, ornamental textures, or tiny unreadable type.
